known_limits: typeblock cannot tell a real word from word-shaped gibberish: a real word burned into a corpus image reads conf 90.4, and issue 26's fabrications 'Eosic'/'Niew'/'Conuum' read 89-93.
An ornate display face can hide a real word below the threshold: issue 30's 'AMPHETAMEME' reads 67.9, below the gibberish on issues 26 and 44.
corner needs OCR to see the mark, so a forgery clean enough to defeat tesseract is invisible to it.
